name: Kilimanjaro International Airport
notes: Read: Tanzania AIP AD 2 extract (TCAA), '2ND EDITION', 'AMDT NR 12', no effective date shown; file name suggests upload in 2018 (https://tcaa.go.tz/ctrback/uploads/docId1521752741544.pdf). This is old and may be superseded; the current Tanzania AIP AD 2 is not published openly (TCAA AIP page https://tcaa.go.tz/pages/aeronautical-information-publication-aip has no document links; refers to ais@tcaa.go.tz). In this extract AD 2.3 shows row labels without values and AD 2.20/2.21 only template text. AD 2.9 remark: 'all ACFT with AUW of 7 tonnes (7,000kg) and above are restricted to make a U turn on LDG/TAXIING RWY 09.' TCAA AIC 3/21 (KADCO security fee) read but has no rules for this list. KADCO website not found in search.
